//http://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/78/E
//Evacuation

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 300;

const int ROOM = -1;
const int REAC = -2;
const int BAD_REAC = -3;
const int CAPS = ROOM;

struct Edge {
    int from, to, rev, flow, cap;
    Edge() : from(0), to(0), rev(0), flow(0), cap(0) {}
    Edge(int f, int t, int r, int fl, int c) : from(f), to(t), rev(r), flow(fl), cap(c) {}
    int residual() const { return cap - flow; }
};

class EdmondsKarp {
public:
    int n;
    vector<Edge*> *adj;
    Edge **parent;
    vector<bool> visited;

    EdmondsKarp(int size) : n(size), adj(new vector<Edge*>[size]), parent(new Edge*[size]), visited(size, false) {}

    ~EdmondsKarp() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (auto e : adj[i]) delete e;
            adj[i].clear();
        }
        delete[] adj;
        delete[] parent;
    }

    void addEdge(int s, int t, int cap) {
        Edge *fwd = new Edge(s, t, (int)adj[t].size(), 0, cap);
        Edge *bkw = new Edge(t, s, (int)adj[s].size(), 0, 0);
        adj[s].push_back(fwd);
        adj[t].push_back(bkw);
    }

    void addUndirected(int s, int t, int cap) {
        Edge *fwd = new Edge(s, t, (int)adj[t].size(), 0, cap);
        Edge *bkw = new Edge(t, s, (int)adj[s].size(), 0, cap);
        adj[s].push_back(fwd);
        adj[t].push_back(bkw);
    }

    bool bfs(int src, int snk) {
        fill(visited.begin(), visited.end(), false);
        fill(parent, parent + n, nullptr);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(src);
        visited[src] = true;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (u == snk) return true;
            for (Edge* e : adj[u]) {
                if (!visited[e->to] && e->residual() > 0) {
                    visited[e->to] = true;
                    parent[e->to] = e;
                    q.push(e->to);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    int augment(int src, int snk) {
        int flow = INT_MAX;
        for (int v = snk; v != src; v = parent[v]->from)
            flow = min(flow, parent[v]->residual());
        for (int v = snk; v != src; v = parent[v]->from) {
            Edge* e = parent[v];
            e->flow += flow;
            adj[e->to][e->rev]->flow -= flow;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    long long maxFlow(int src, int snk) {
        long long total = 0;
        while (bfs(src, snk)) total += augment(src, snk);
        return total;
    }
};

int grid[MAXN][MAXN], checkpoint[MAXN][MAXN], poison[61][MAXN][MAXN];

struct Point {
    int x, y, cnt;
    Point(int a, int b, int c) : x(a), y(b), cnt(c) {}
    bool inBounds(int N) const {
        return x >= 0 && x < N && y >= 0 && y < N && grid[x][y] == ROOM;
    }
};

bool valid(int x, int y, int N) { return Point(x, y, 0).inBounds(N); }

inline bool operator==(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
    return a.x == b.x && a.y == b.y;
}

vector<Point> people, pods;
int dx[] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
int dy[] = {0, -1, 0, 1};

int decode(char c) {
    switch (c) {
        case '0': case '1': case '2': case '3': case '4':
        case '5': case '6': case '7': case '8': case '9':
            return ROOM;
        case 'Y': return REAC;
        case 'Z': return BAD_REAC;
    }
    return -1;
}

int amount(char c) { return c - '0'; }

int bfs_dist(Point src, Point dst, int N) {
    bitset<MAXN> seen[MAXN];
    queue<pair<int, Point>> q;
    q.push({0, src});
    seen[src.x][src.y] = true;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        int t = q.front().first;
        Point cur = q.front().second;
        q.pop();

        if (cur == dst) return t;
        if (poison[t][cur.x][cur.y]) continue;

        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
            Point nxt(cur.x + dx[i], cur.y + dy[i], 0);
            if (nxt.inBounds(N) && !seen[nxt.x][nxt.y] && !poison[t][nxt.x][nxt.y]) {
                q.push({t + 1, nxt});
                seen[nxt.x][nxt.y] = true;
            }
        }
    }
    return 999;
}

void spread_poison(int x, int y, int T, int N) {
    poison[0][x][y] = 1;
    for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (poison[t-1][i][j]) {
                    poison[t][i][j] = 1;
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                        int ni = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                        if (valid(ni, nj, N)) poison[t][ni][nj] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    int N, T;
    scanf("%d %d", &N, &T);

    char c;
    Point badSpot{0, 0, 0};
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            scanf(" %c", &c);
            if (decode(c) == ROOM && amount(c)) {
                people.emplace_back(i, j, amount(c));
            }
            grid[i][j] = decode(c);
            if (grid[i][j] == BAD_REAC) badSpot = Point(i, j, 0);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            scanf(" %c", &c);
            if (decode(c) == CAPS && amount(c)) {
                pods.emplace_back(i, j, amount(c));
                checkpoint[i][j] = amount(c);
            }
        }
    }

    EdmondsKarp *g = new EdmondsKarp(MAXN);
    int sink = MAXN - 1;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < people.size(); ++i)
        g->addEdge(0, i*2 + 1, people[i].cnt);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < pods.size(); ++i)
        g->addEdge(i*2 + 2, sink, pods[i].cnt);

    spread_poison(badSpot.x, badSpot.y, T, N);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < people.size(); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < pods.size(); ++j) {
            int d = bfs_dist(people[i], pods[j], N);
            if (d <= T) g->addEdge(i*2 + 1, j*2 + 2, 999);
        }
    }

    printf("%lld\n", g->maxFlow(0, sink));
    delete g;
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

constexpr int MAXN = 300;

enum CellType { ROOM = -1, REAC = -2, BAD_REAC = -3, CAPS = ROOM };

struct Edge {
    int src, dst, backIdx, flow, capacity;
    Edge() : src(0), dst(0), backIdx(0), flow(0), capacity(0) {}
    Edge(int s, int d, int b, int f, int c) : src(s), dst(d), backIdx(b), flow(f), capacity(c) {}
    int remaining() const { return capacity - flow; }
};

class MaxFlowSolver {
public:
    int nodes;
    vector<Edge*>* graph;
    Edge** parent;
    vector<char> mark;

    MaxFlowSolver(int sz) : nodes(sz), graph(new vector<Edge*>[sz]), parent(new Edge*[sz]), mark(sz, 0) {}

    ~MaxFlowSolver() {
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes; ++i) {
            for (auto* e : graph[i]) delete e;
            graph[i].clear();
        }
        delete[] graph;
        delete[] parent;
    }

    void connect(int u, int v, int cap) {
        Edge* f = new Edge(u, v, (int)graph[v].size(), 0, cap);
        Edge* r = new Edge(v, u, (int)graph[u].size(), 0, 0);
        graph[u].push_back(f);
        graph[v].push_back(r);
    }

    void bidirectional(int u, int v, int cap) {
        Edge* f = new Edge(u, v, (int)graph[v].size(), 0, cap);
        Edge* r = new Edge(v, u, (int)graph[u].size(), 0, cap);
        graph[u].push_back(f);
        graph[v].push_back(r);
    }

    bool findPath(int s, int t) {
        fill(mark.begin(), mark.end(), 0);
        fill(parent, parent + nodes, nullptr);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        mark[s] = 1;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (u == t) return true;
            for (Edge* e : graph[u]) {
                if (!mark[e->dst] && e->remaining() > 0) {
                    mark[e->dst] = 1;
                    parent[e->dst] = e;
                    q.push(e->dst);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    int pushFlow(int s, int t) {
        int bottleneck = INT_MAX;
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]->src)
            bottleneck = min(bottleneck, parent[v]->remaining());
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]->src) {
            Edge* e = parent[v];
            e->flow += bottleneck;
            graph[e->dst][e->backIdx]->flow -= bottleneck;
        }
        return bottleneck;
    }

    long long compute(int s, int t) {
        long long total = 0;
        while (findPath(s, t)) total += pushFlow(s, t);
        return total;
    }
};

int mapGrid[MAXN][MAXN], safeZone[MAXN][MAXN], toxic[61][MAXN][MAXN];

struct Agent {
    int r, c, count;
    Agent(int x, int y, int n) : r(x), c(y), count(n) {}
    bool inside(int size) const {
        return r >= 0 && r < size && c >= 0 && c < size && mapGrid[r][c] == ROOM;
    }
};

bool ok(int x, int y, int size) { return Agent(x, y, 0).inside(size); }

inline bool operator==(const Agent& a, const Agent& b) {
    return a.r == b.r && a.c == b.c;
}

vector<Agent> survivors, shelters;
const int dr[4] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
const int dc[4] = {0, -1, 0, 1};

int parseCell(char ch) {
    if (isdigit(ch)) return ROOM;
    if (ch == 'Y') return REAC;
    if (ch == 'Z') return BAD_REAC;
    return -1;
}

int parseCount(char ch) { return ch - '0'; }

int shortestPath(Agent start, Agent end, int size) {
    bitset<MAXN> visited[MAXN];
    queue<pair<int, Agent>> q;
    q.push({0, start});
    visited[start.r][start.c] = true;

    while (!q.empty()) {
        int time = q.front().first;
        Agent cur = q.front().second;
        q.pop();

        if (cur == end) return time;
        if (toxic[time][cur.r][cur.c]) continue;

        for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
            Agent next(cur.r + dr[k], cur.c + dc[k], 0);
            if (next.inside(size) && !visited[next.r][next.c] && !toxic[time][next.r][next.c]) {
                q.push({time + 1, next});
                visited[next.r][next.c] = true;
            }
        }
    }
    return 999;
}

void propagateToxicity(int x, int y, int duration, int size) {
    toxic[0][x][y] = 1;
    for (int t = 1; t <= duration; ++t) {
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; ++j) {
                if (toxic[t-1][i][j]) {
                    toxic[t][i][j] = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int ni = i + dr[k], nj = j + dc[k];
                        if (ni >= 0 && ni < size && nj >= 0 && nj < size && mapGrid[ni][nj] == ROOM)
                            toxic[t][ni][nj] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    int N, T;
    scanf("%d %d", &N, &T);

    char ch;
    Agent hazard{0, 0, 0};
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            scanf(" %c", &ch);
            if (parseCell(ch) == ROOM && parseCount(ch)) {
                survivors.emplace_back(i, j, parseCount(ch));
            }
            mapGrid[i][j] = parseCell(ch);
            if (mapGrid[i][j] == BAD_REAC) hazard = Agent(i, j, 0);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            scanf(" %c", &ch);
            if (parseCell(ch) == CAPS && parseCount(ch)) {
                shelters.emplace_back(i, j, parseCount(ch));
                safeZone[i][j] = parseCount(ch);
            }
        }
    }

    MaxFlowSolver* solver = new MaxFlowSolver(MAXN);
    int sinkNode = MAXN - 1;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < survivors.size(); ++i)
        solver->connect(0, i*2 + 1, survivors[i].count);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < shelters.size(); ++i)
        solver->connect(i*2 + 2, sinkNode, shelters[i].count);

    propagateToxicity(hazard.r, hazard.c, T, N);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < survivors.size(); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < shelters.size(); ++j) {
            int dist = shortestPath(survivors[i], shelters[j], N);
            if (dist <= T) solver->connect(i*2 + 1, j*2 + 2, 999);
        }
    }

    printf("%lld\n", solver->compute(0, sinkNode));
    delete solver;
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

const int MAX_SIZE = 300;

enum Cell { EMPTY = -1, REACTION = -2, HAZARD = -3, SHELTER = EMPTY };

struct Link {
    int u, v, reverse, current, limit;
    Link() : u(0), v(0), reverse(0), current(0), limit(0) {}
    Link(int a, int b, int r, int c, int l) : u(a), v(b), reverse(r), current(c), limit(l) {}
    int spare() const { return limit - current; }
};

class FlowNetwork {
public:
    int V;
    vector<Link*>* adj;
    Link** par;
    vector<int> seen;

    FlowNetwork(int n) : V(n), adj(new vector<Link*>[n]), par(new Link*[n]), seen(n, 0) {}

    ~FlowNetwork() {
        for (int i = 0; i < V; ++i) {
            for (auto* e : adj[i]) delete e;
            adj[i].clear();
        }
        delete[] adj;
        delete[] par;
    }

    void link(int a, int b, int cap) {
        Link* f = new Link(a, b, (int)adj[b].size(), 0, cap);
        Link* r = new Link(b, a, (int)adj[a].size(), 0, 0);
        adj[a].push_back(f);
        adj[b].push_back(r);
    }

    void bidirect(int a, int b, int cap) {
        Link* f = new Link(a, b, (int)adj[b].size(), 0, cap);
        Link* r = new Link(b, a, (int)adj[a].size(), 0, cap);
        adj[a].push_back(f);
        adj[b].push_back(r);
    }

    bool explore(int src, int dst) {
        fill(seen.begin(), seen.end(), 0);
        fill(par, par + V, nullptr);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(src);
        seen[src] = 1;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int cur = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (cur == dst) return true;
            for (Link* e : adj[cur]) {
                if (!seen[e->v] && e->spare() > 0) {
                    seen[e->v] = 1;
                    par[e->v] = e;
                    q.push(e->v);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    int augment(int src, int dst) {
        int flow = INT_MAX;
        for (int v = dst; v != src; v = par[v]->u)
            flow = min(flow, par[v]->spare());
        for (int v = dst; v != src; v = par[v]->u) {
            Link* e = par[v];
            e->current += flow;
            adj[e->v][e->reverse]->current -= flow;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    long long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        long long total = 0;
        while (explore(s, t)) total += augment(s, t);
        return total;
    }
};

int layout[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE], capacity[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE], danger[61][MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];

struct Pos {
    int r, c, val;
    Pos(int x, int y, int n) : r(x), c(y), val(n) {}
    bool inGrid(int sz) const {

vector<Pos> candidates, exits;
const int dRow[4] = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
const int dCol[4] = {0, -1, 0, 1};

int classify(char c) {

    if (c == 'Y') return REACTION;
    if (c == 'Z') return HAZARD;

                q.push({t + 1, next});
                seen[next.r][next.c] = true;

void contaminate(int x, int y, int limit, int sz) {
    danger[0][x][y] = 1;
    for (int t = 1; t <= limit; ++t) {
        for (int i = 0; i < sz; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < sz; ++j) {
                if (danger[t-1][i][j]) {
                    danger[t][i][j] = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                        int ni = i + dRow[k], nj = j + dCol[k];
                        if (ni >= 0 && ni < sz && nj >= 0 && nj < sz && layout[ni][nj] == EMPTY)
                            danger[t][ni][nj] = 1;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < exits.size(); ++j) {
            int d = distance(candidates[i], exits[j], N);
            if (d <= T) net->link(i*2 + 1, j*2 + 2, 999);

class DinicLike {
public:

    DinicLike(int n) : V(n), adj(new vector<Connection*>[n]), prevEdge(new Connection*[n]), dist(n, -1) {}

        Connection* r = new Connection(v, u, (int)adj[u].size(), 0, 0);
        adj[u].push_back(f);
        adj[v].push_back(r);

        Connection* r = new Connection(v, u, (int)adj[u].size(), 0, c);

        adj[v].push_back(r);

                    q.push(e->finish);
                }

            if (dist[e->finish] == dist[u] + 1 && e->left() > 0) {

struct Arc {
    int origin, terminus, reverse, current, limit;
    Arc() : origin(0), terminus(0), reverse(0), current(0), limit(0) {}
    Arc(int o, int t, int r, int c, int l) : origin(o), terminus(t), reverse(r), current(c), limit(l) {}
    int available() const { return limit - current; }
};

class FlowEngine {
public:
    int vertexCount;
    vector<Arc*>* adjacency;
    Arc** parentArc;
    vector<int> level;

    FlowEngine(int n) : vertexCount(n), adjacency(new vector<Arc*>[n]), parentArc(new Arc*[n]), level(n, -1) {}

    ~FlowEngine() {
        for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; ++i) {
            for (auto* e : adjacency[i]) delete e;
            adjacency[i].clear();
        }
        delete[] adjacency;
        delete[] parentArc;
    }

    void addArc(int u, int v, int cap) {
        Arc* forward = new Arc(u, v, (int)adjacency[v].size(), 0, cap);
        Arc* backward = new Arc(v, u, (int)adjacency[u].size(), 0, 0);
        adjacency[u].push_back(forward);
        adjacency[v].push_back(backward);
    }

    void addSymmetric(int u, int v, int cap) {
        Arc* forward = new Arc(u, v, (int)adjacency[v].size(), 0, cap);
        Arc* backward = new Arc(v, u, (int)adjacency[u].size(), 0, cap);
        adjacency[u].push_back(forward);
        adjacency[v].push_back(backward);
    }

    bool buildLevels(int source, int sink) {
        fill(level.begin(), level.end(), -1);
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(source);
        level[source] = 0;

        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            if (u == sink) return true;
            for (Arc* e : adjacency[u]) {
                if (level[e->terminus] == -1 && e->available() > 0) {
                    level[e->terminus] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.push(e->terminus);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    int push(int u, int sink, int flowLimit) {
        if (u == sink) return flowLimit;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)adjacency[u].size(); ++i) {
            Arc*& e = adjacency[u][i];
            if (level[e->terminus] == level[u] + 1 && e->available() > 0) {
                int pushed = push(e->terminus, sink, min(flowLimit, e->available()));
                if (pushed) {
                    e->current += pushed;
                    adjacency[e->terminus][e->reverse].current -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    long long totalFlow(int src, int snk) {
        long long result = 0;
        while (buildLevels(src, snk)) {
            int pushed;
            while ((pushed = push(src, snk, INT_MAX)) > 0) {
                result += pushed;
            }
        }
